subject: [PATCH v3 5/5] fs/proc/task_mmu: account device-private PMDs as present in smaps

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where device-private PMDs were not being accounted for correctly in the smaps output. Specifically, it ensures that these PMDs are marked as present when calculating memory usage, which affects how PSS and private/shared accounting is done.
